response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong track record in web, backend, and low-latency services (notably high-throughput D services at Sociomantic), plus community teaching and open-source leadership. However, the role's core minimum bar — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; his C/C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments and a university thesis project. He also lacks demonstrable experience building or leading large-scale cloud compute platforms, and has held no formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The mismatch on hard minimum qualifications outweighs his general engineering breadth.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured engineering career across backend, infra, and embedded
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed services experience (millions req/s)
Strong mentoring signal: workshops, courses, talks, OSS project ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months)
No production cloud compute platform architecture or ownership
No formal technical lead role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers
